name: elements.data item records, 1.7.3 e344 (partial; only what we have mapped)
note: elements.data is not parsed list by list yet. Items are found by their name field: the item id sits 4, 8 or 12 bytes before the name depending on the record kind [verified on many items].

id_positions.kind: equipment-like records: id, major type, sub type, name (e.g. Bless Boxes 21213/21285, wings, fashion)

fields.name: flags
fields.note: 0x1 no drop on death, 0x2 no discard, 0x4 no sell, 0x10 no trade, 0x4000 no account stash
